title: Account recovery & guardians
intro: If you lose every device, people you chose in advance can confirm that your new device really is yours. No secret key to store, no password to remember — just people who trust you.

banner.title: Guardians for your account
banner.desc: To enjoy the advanced encryption features, it's worth choosing now who can approve your new device if you ever lose all of them.

set.title: Your guardians
set.none: No guardians yet. If you lose every device, recovery goes through a 48-hour reset the server approves.
set.effective: In force: {{threshold}} of {{total}} can approve a new device
set.pending: A new list was signed and takes effect on {{date}}. Until then the previous list stays in force.
set.noPartners: You don't have rikma partners yet. You can add any user by exact username or email.
set.minGuardians: Choose at least two guardians. A single guardian is a single point of failure.
set.saved: Signed. Each guardian was asked to agree. The list takes effect in 72 hours, once enough of them have agreed.
set.delayNote: A new list takes effect only after 72 hours, and you get an email about it. That way a thief holding an unlocked device can't swap your guardians and recover straight away.
set.tip: Pick people who would recognise you by voice or in person, and who are unlikely to all be reachable by a con artist on the same day.
set.pendingConsent: A new list was signed. It takes effect on {{date}}, provided at least {{threshold}} guardians have agreed. Until then the previous list stays in force.

alerts.title: A recovery is under way on your account
alerts.desc: A new device is asking to join your account with your guardians' approval. If this isn't you, you can stop it here.
alerts.readyAt: The device registers on {{date}} unless someone objects
alerts.protested: Objection recorded on {{date}}. Approvals given until then were voided.
alerts.protestConfirm: Stop this recovery? Every approval given so far is voided, and guardians would have to approve again.

vouch.title: Approve the device of someone who chose you
vouch.desc: Did someone who named you as a guardian lose their devices? Type the code they read to you.
vouch.who: {{name}} is recovering their account on a new device
vouch.fingerprintAsk: Ask them to read the fingerprint shown on the new screen, and compare it with this one:
vouch.confirm: I spoke with them by voice or in person, it really is them, and the fingerprint matches
vouch.notFound: Code not found, or you're not on this user's guardian list
vouch.protestedWarn: Heads up: the account owner objected to an earlier recovery of this device. Make very sure it's really them.

recover.title: I lost all my devices
recover.desc: This device will ask your guardians to confirm it's yours. Once enough of them approve, there is a 24-hour window in which a surviving old device can object. Then the device registers.
recover.code: Code to read to your guardians
recover.readTo: Call each guardian, read them the code, and ask them to read back the fingerprint they see.
recover.done: Device registered. Your rikma partners will share the keys with it the next time the encrypted data is opened.
recover.noGuardians: This account has no guardians in force. You can use a chain reset on the devices page.
recover.protested: An old device of this account objected to the recovery. Guardians need to approve again.

guarding.title: You've been asked to be a guardian
guarding.desc: A guardian is asked to confirm — by voice or in person — that a new device really belongs to the person who chose them. It only counts once you agree, and you can step down at any time.
guarding.asked: {{name}} asked you to be one of their guardians ({{threshold}} of {{total}} approve a new device)
guarding.stepDownConfirm: Stop being {{name}}'s guardian? They'll get an email so they can choose someone else.
